verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile documents natural-language Copilot interaction in the app: users can ask Copilot about repositories and open a new pull request "all in natural language," and they can start Copilot agent tasks from the phone. The docs do not show that the app's broader operations (triage, review, merge, notifications, navigation) can be driven by natural-language commands; most of those actions remain manual UI steps. Missing for 10: natural-language control of core app operations beyond Copilot chat, PR creation and agent tasks, documentation of the in-app command scope and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mobile natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask Copilot to break down complex coding concepts, guide you through unfamiliar codebases, provide insights into both public and your private repositories, and open a new pull request – all in natural language.
Agent Tasks are now on GitHub Mobile, giving developers a centralized way to manage Copilot cloud agent tasks wherever they are. Easily start new tasks and keep track of progress
Assign issues to Copilot and get a ready-to-review pull request. Use comments to refine, iterate, approve and merge—all directly within GitHub Mobile.
